Once upon a time:
, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue loved to eat grapes. One day, she went to the garden to pick some grapes. But there was a problem. There was a big, angry dog who was sitting under a tree.
Sue was scared, but she did not want to be disturbed. She said, "Please, can I have some grapes?" The angry dog said, "No, you cannot have grapes. I only have one for myself." Sue was sad, but she did not know what to do.
Just then, a friendly bird flew down and said, "I can give you some grapes." Sue gave the bird some grapes. The angry dog ate the grapes and was not angry anymore. Sue and the angry dog became friends. They played together in the garden and shared the grapes. The moral of the story is to listen to your friends and not disturb them when they need you.
